fun_fact: Перед зимней спячкой бурый медведь так много ест, что за лето и осень сильно толстеет, а потом спит почти всю зиму, ничего не кушая.
hint: Один из самых крупных хищников на суше: тяжелее любого человека и бегает быстрее олимпийского чемпиона.

bite_force_psi.note: GRIZZLY figure. Wikipedia: 'has been measured at over 8 megapascals (1,200 psi)', but no primary measurement could be traced; popular sites give 975-1,160 psi. Marked estimated for safety. Brown bear BFQ = 78 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bite_force_quotient).

weight_kg.note: avg = mean of adult males from 19 populations (Brown bear article; general range 80-600 kg; inland males ~180 kg, coastal ~2x heavier). max = largest recorded WILD male, a KODIAK bear (source for max: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kodiak_bear). Captive Kodiak 'Clyde' weighed 966 kg at death (1987).

height_m.note: Shoulder height. Brown bear article gives 1.5 m (no sex split). Spread: grizzly avg 1.02 m (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grizzly_bear), Kodiak male avg 1.33 m, large Kodiak 1.5 m (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kodiak_bear). Standing on hind legs a large Kodiak can reach ~3 m.

length_m.note: Head-and-body length range 1-2.8 m (both sexes); avg = midpoint. Kodiak adult male avg total length 2.44 m (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kodiak_bear).

speed_kmh.note: GRIZZLY: 'maximum speed reliably recorded at Yellowstone is 48 km/h (30 mph)'; unverified claim of 56 km/h. Confirmed by 1937 Yellowstone Nature Notes (clocked 25, 28, 30 mph): https://npshistory.com/nature_notes/yell/vol14-1-2a.htm

lifespan_years.note: avg = 'average lifespan of 25 years in the wild' (grizzly males est. 22). max = Andreas, 'at least 50' at death in 2013 at Arcturos sanctuary (captive). Oldest wild individual nearly 37.

fun_fact: Под белой шубой у белого медведя чёрная кожа, а сами волоски шерсти прозрачные и только кажутся белыми.
hint: Самый большой хищник на суше, который отлично плавает в ледяном океане.

weight_kg.note: Males 300-800 kg; avg = midpoint. San Diego Zoo: most males 300-635 kg (https://animals.sandiegozoo.org/animals/polar-bear). max = male shot at Kotzebue Sound, Alaska, 1960, 'reportedly' 1,002 kg (wild, not fully verified).

height_m.note: Shoulder height 130-160 cm (adults, no sex split); avg = midpoint, max = top of range. San Diego Zoo says ~1.7 m.

length_m.note: Males 200-250 cm long (Wikipedia does not say whether total or head-and-body); avg = midpoint. San Diego Zoo head-and-body 1.8-2.7 m.

speed_kmh.note: 'can run at estimated speeds of up to 40 km/h' - estimate, not a clocked measurement.

lifespan_years.note: avg = San Diego Zoo males 15-18 years (females 20-25); midpoint. Wikipedia only says 'can live up to 30 years'. max = Debby, Assiniboine Park Zoo, died 2008 aged 41 (some say 41-42), captive, Guinness-certified oldest polar bear (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Debby_(polar_bear)).

fun_fact: Гориллы почти всё время едят растения, а каждый вечер строят себе новую кровать-гнездо из веток и листьев.
hint: Самая большая обезьяна на свете, главный самец с серебристой спиной.

bite_force_psi.note: WEAK SOURCE: popular site, no study cited; widely repeated figure, other sites give 600-1,500 psi. Not in Wikipedia/NatGeo/Smithsonian. Skull-model work (Wroe, via Discover) only says gorilla molar bite exceeds human 1,100-1,300 N. Consider dropping if strict sourcing required.

weight_kg.note: avg = western lowland male average 140 kg (Western lowland gorilla article; genus article gives 136-227 kg). max = heaviest WILD gorilla, a 1.83 m silverback at 267 kg (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gorilla). Captive males up to 310 kg.

height_m.note: Standing upright, western lowland male avg 1.67 m; 'up to 1.83 m'. Genus range 1.4-1.8 m (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gorilla).

lifespan_years.note: Wild 35-40 years; avg = midpoint. max = Fatou (female, Berlin Zoo, captive, still living, ~69 y 302 d as of Oct 2026; birth date approximate) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oldest_hominids. Oldest male lived 61 years.

fun_fact: Шимпанзе умеют пользоваться инструментами: палочкой они достают из термитника термитов, а камнем раскалывают орехи.
hint: Наш самый близкий родственник среди животных: меньше человека, но очень сильный для своего роста.

weight_kg.note: avg = wild male average 40 kg. max = 'up to 136 kg in captivity' (captive).

height_m.note: Average standing height 150 cm (adults, no sex split); exceptional individuals 'over 168 cm' on two legs.

lifespan_years.note: Wild life expectancy varies hugely by site: Ngogo ~33, Kanyawara ~20, Gombe 18, Tai 13; avg = midpoint of 13-33 (spread >1.5x). max = Joao, male, Chimp Eden sanctuary (captive), ~83 y 302 d as of Oct 2026, birth only estimated 1943-1948 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oldest_hominids).

fun_fact: Орангутаны почти всю жизнь проводят на деревьях, а в дождь могут накрыться большим листом, как зонтиком.
hint: Рыжая обезьяна с очень длинными руками, которая живёт на деревьях острова Борнео.

weight_kg.note: avg = male average 75 kg (range 50-100 kg, wild survey). max = 'Andy', obese CAPTIVE male, 204 kg in 1959.

height_m.note: Wikipedia gives male BODY LENGTH 1.2-1.7 m, not standing height; avg = midpoint. Use with caution as height.

lifespan_years.note: Wild 35-45 years; avg = midpoint. max = 'in captivity it can live to be about 60' (approximate). News reports mention a Bornean female at Tama Zoo, Tokyo, ~62; Puan (Perth, 62) is usually listed as Sumatran; oldest orangutan overall Bella (~65, Hagenbeck) species not stated.

fun_fact: Человек не самый сильный и не самый быстрый, зато может бежать очень долго и придумывает инструменты, которые помогают ему во всём.
hint: Это ты сам — с тобой сравнивают всех остальных животных.

bite_force_psi.note: Discover: 'the bite force of a measly human is just 162 psi' (links Cleveland Clinic; no primary study). Other popular sources 120-200 psi. Clinical studies report force in newtons: male molar mean ~465-486 N (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7570304). Record: Richard Hofmann 442 kg-force (975 lbf, not psi), Guinness (https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/75273-strongest-human-bite) - max left null because it is force, not psi.

strength_kg.note: avg = untrained man deadlift '90 kilograms (70-120)' (fitness site, not peer-reviewed; game's 70 kg reference sits at bottom of range). max = deadlift world record 510 kg, Hafthor Bjornsson, 6 Sep 2025 (https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/heaviest-deadlift.html).

weight_kg.note: avg = average adult male mass 77 kg. max = Jon Brower Minnoch ~635 kg, ESTIMATED, not weighed (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jon_Brower_Minnoch); heaviest precisely measured: Robert Earl Hughes 485 kg (Guinness).

height_m.note: avg = worldwide average adult male height ~171 cm. max = Robert Wadlow 2.72 m (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Wadlow).

speed_kmh.note: avg = Usain Bolt's average over his 9.58 s 100 m world record (Berlin 2009); max = his fastest 60-80 m split average 44.72 km/h (split average, not instantaneous). Typical untrained man is much slower.

lifespan_years.note: avg = world life expectancy at birth 73.3 (2019). max = Jeanne Calment, 122 years 164 days, longest verified human lifespan (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jeanne_Calment).
